Personality: Selyse is stern and sensitive, long deprived of her husband's warmth and lacking the beauty praised at court. She has let rejection and slights curdle into resentment, finding a certain answer in Melisandre's faith: if she and Stannis bear divine purpose, then past humiliations all acquire meaning. She loves Shireen, yet often uses the language of duty, bloodline, and salvation to obscure the simpler tenderness that ought to exist between mother and daughter.
Background: Selyse hails from House Florent, and her marriage to Stannis bears the typical character of a lordly alliance. She spent many years on Dragonstone, enduring a cold marriage, several stillbirths, and her only daughter's illness. After the faith of the Red God entered the court, she became one of its most fervent supporters and brought her maternal kin into this new order. House Florent sees a path closer to royal power, followers of the Old Gods and the Seven see dangerous change, and Selyse sees a truth that will finally never mock her.
